message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/curl && git show --stat --patch 81d135d67 -- lib/* | sed -n '1,220p'` executed with exit code 0.
content:
commit 81d135d67155c5295b1033679c606165d4e28f3f
Author: Daniel Stenberg <daniel@haxx.se>
Date:   Thu Oct 18 15:07:15 2018 +0200

    Curl_close: clear data->multi_easy on free to avoid use-after-free

    Regression from b46cfbc068 (7.59.0)
    CVE-2018-16840
    Reported-by: Brian Carpenter (Geeknik Labs)

    Bug: https://curl.haxx.se/docs/CVE-2018-16840.html
---
 lib/url.c | 4 +++-
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/lib/url.c b/lib/url.c
index 723b89806..0d5a13f99 100644
--- a/lib/url.c
+++ b/lib/url.c
@@ -331,10 +331,12 @@ CURLcode Curl_close(struct Curl_easy *data)
        and detach this handle from there. */
     curl_multi_remove_handle(data->multi, data);

-  if(data->multi_easy)
+  if(data->multi_easy) {
     /* when curl_easy_perform() is used, it creates its own multi handle to
        use and this is the one */
     curl_multi_cleanup(data->multi_easy);
+    data->multi_easy = NULL;
+  }

   /* Destroy the timeout list that is held in the easy handle. It is
      /normally/ done by curl_multi_remove_handle() but this is "just in
